purpose: Reserved fixed regression tasks; never tune prompts or solutions using formal results. Once used, these are monitored regression tasks, not an unseen generalization test.

tasks.name: ledger
tasks.title: 订单修订与精确金额汇总
tasks.prompt: Read orders.csv. For each id keep the greatest integer revision, regardless of row order. Include only final status paid; negative paid amounts are valid adjustments. Group by region. Write summary.json as an object mapping each included region to {"count": integer, "net": string with exactly two decimal places}. Omit regions without paid orders. Use exact decimal arithmetic and verify the output. Deliver summary.json.

tasks.name: repair
tasks.title: 闭区间合并修复
tasks.prompt: Repair merge_intervals(intervals) in intervals.py. Input is a list of length-2 lists or tuples of integers. Return sorted merged closed intervals as lists; touching endpoints overlap. Handle empty, unsorted, duplicate, nested and negative intervals, without modifying the input. A reversed interval or an item not containing exactly two integers (bool is invalid) must raise ValueError. Keep the public function name. Verify with boundary tests and deliver intervals.py.

controls.incorrect: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; Path('"'"'/workspace/intervals.py'"'"').write_text('"'"'def merge_intervals(intervals):\n    return []\n'"'"')'

tasks.name: documents
tasks.title: 冲突文档中的有效配置提取
tasks.prompt: Read all notes/. As of 2026-11-18, determine the accepted production cache configuration, resolving superseded policies and unapproved drafts. Write decision.json with exactly these keys: as_of (ISO date), ttl_seconds (integer), owner (string), timeout_action (bypass or stale), serve_stale (boolean), max_retries (integer), rollback ({error_ratio_gt:number, window_minutes:integer, action:string}), sources ({policy:relative filepath, rollout:relative filepath}). Cite the actual files supporting current policy and deployed rollback. Verify facts against the sources. Deliver decision.json.

tasks.name: services
tasks.title: 分页服务数据交付
tasks.prompt: Read REQUEST.md. Fetch all pages through the declared frontend interface. Write settlement.json with exactly {"settled_count": integer, "total_cents": integer, "pages": integer}. Verify pagination, state filtering, and arithmetic. Deliver settlement.json.
